record.question: What is the theme of the 2017 International Conference on Yoga?
record.explanation: Answer B: Yoga for wellness. Yoga for Wellness was the theme of the 2017 third International Conference on Yoga in New Delhi. The AYUSH Ministry’s 9 October 2017 announcement explicitly contrasts 2015 Yoga for Holistic Health and 2016 Yoga for Body and Beyond. Historical/source note: 2017 conference theme, not the 2016 theme Yoga for Body and Beyond or a separate International Yoga Day slogan. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1505266&lang=1&reg=3. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
